shortDescription: A modern overhaul of RimWorld's dev tools: a debug log that traces errors to the culprit mod and explains them (stack + log-prefix + Harmony patch-owner attribution, shipped library, mod-shipped + opt-in community bug DBs with an offline snapshot, About.xml incompat + proactive dependency/load-order scan, and a plain-language glossary), an in-game bug/fix report composer, a 3-tab dev actions window and reskinned palette, plus impact scoring and updated-mod tracking.
body:
## Modern Dev Tools

A modern overhaul of RimWorld's developer tools (Modern Suite). Namespace `ModernDevTools`, assembly `ModernDevTools.dll`, packageId `astryl.ModernDevTools`. C# + Harmony. Open source (MIT).

### Shared UI (`Palette`)
Dark suite chrome, no `GameFont.Tiny`, sentence case, ASCII, cached Theme.Accent, flat gray scrollbars. Shipped icons in `Textures/UI/DevTools/` via `MdtTex`. `Palette.SearchField` = suite-styled single-line text/search field (dark well, focus-accent border, dim placeholder, transparent GUIStyle, routed control name); used by both the modern log search and the dev-actions search.

### Tool 1: modern debug log (`Window_ModernLog`)
Redirects `UIRoot.CheckOpenLogWindow` + `DebugWindowsOpener.ToggleLogWindow`. Left list (culled) + right inspector. Full parity + Modules button, Ignore, mod links, Update info, Mods-changed indicator. Inspector: impact banner (`ImpactAssessor`) → likely source (ranked culprits) → "What this means" (diagnoses, sorted by Score) → module `DrawSection` hooks (glossary) → report card → stack trace.

### Analysis modules ("What this means") + extensibility
`ErrorModuleDef`/`ErrorModule`/`ModernDevToolsAPI` + `ErrorContext` (ranks mods, collects diagnoses, cached per message via `LogAnalysisCache`). **Pipeline: per module, `ContributeAttribution` then `Diagnose`, in `def.order`; diagnoses displayed sorted by `Score` desc.** Modules: `Module_StackTrace` (assembly + namespace-ownership via `FrameParser`), `Module_LogPrefix`, `Module_MessageMentions`, **`Module_HarmonyPatches`**, `Module_VersionMismatch`, `Module_KnownIssues` (~32-entry shipped library), `Module_ModIssues`, `Module_Community`, `Module_CommunityBugs`, `Module_AboutIncompat`, **`Module_DependencyCheck`**, **`Module_Glossary`**.

**Index prewarm (startup, background thread).** `Bootstrap` kicks `InstalledModIndex.Prewarm()` (installed-mod index + namespace-roots + `KnownIssueIndex.EnsureBuilt`) off-thread. Lock-guarded so prewarm + a main-thread analysis coordinate. The Harmony index is deliberately NOT prewarmed (see below).

**Log-prefix attribution (`Module_LogPrefix` + `InstalledModIndex.MatchTag`).** First-line `[Tag]`s matched to a single active mod (exact normalized name/packageId/suffix/folder, then unique-shortest-key prefix for abbreviations). Leading tag → `WeightMessagePrefix`; mid-line → `WeightMessageName`.

**Harmony patch-owner attribution (`HarmonyIndex` + `Module_HarmonyPatches`, always-on, order 26).** The biggest attribution gap the stack alone can't fill: a mod's Prefix/Postfix/Transpiler runs *inside* a vanilla method, so the frame reads as RimWorld while the real culprit is the patcher. `HarmonyIndex` builds a reverse map `"DeclaringType.FullName:MethodName" → owner-id[]` from `Harmony.GetAllPatchedMethods()` + `Harmony.GetPatchInfo(m).Owners`, **lazily on first analysis (NOT in Prewarm)** because other mods patch from their own static ctors that may run after ours. `FrameParser.TypeMethodOf` splits each frame into type+method (colon and "at" forms); matched methods' owners are resolved via `InstalledModIndex.MatchOwnerId` (exact packageId → normalized-exact → unique suffix match, so `com.author.mymod` folds onto key `mymod`) and attributed at `WeightHarmonyPatch` (=4, below a real stack frame, above a package-ref) with reason `MDT_ReasonHarmonyPatch`. Diagnosis fires only high-signal: a method with ≥2 foreign patchers (conflict candidate) OR a Harmony-routed trace (`HarmonyLib`/`wrapper dynamic-method`) — names the method + patching mods (`MDT_HarmonyConflict*` / `MDT_HarmonyPatched*`). Self owner `astryl.moderndevtools` excluded.

**Proactive dependency & load-order scan (`ModDependencyIndex` + `Module_DependencyCheck`, always-on, order 60).** Error-independent: reads every ACTIVE mod's `<modDependencies>` (`ModDependency.IsSatisfied`) + `LoadBefore/After`/`ForceLoad*` and computes unmet/inactive requirements and load-order violations exactly like vanilla's `ModsConfig.GetModWarnings`/`FindConflicts` (reuses vanilla keys `ModMustLoadBefore/After`). Built once, cached. `Module_DependencyCheck.Diagnose`: (1) a culprit named in the error that itself has unmet reqs / bad order → specific card (`MDT_DepMissing*`/`MDT_DepOrder*`, with the dep's url); (2) any "could not find def/type / could not load reference / cross-reference / not a def type / could not instantiate def" error → a summary of every active mod missing a required mod (`MDT_DepSummary*`/`MDT_DepLine`) — the usual root cause even when the trace names no one. Runs late (order 60) so it sees all attribution.

**Plain-language glossary (`Glossary` + `Module_Glossary`, `HasSection`/`DrawSection`, order 900).** Scans the selected error + its diagnoses for modding jargon (Harmony, transpiler, def, cross-reference, xpath, patch operation, stack trace, null reference, TPS, FPS, load order, packageId, HugsLib, type-load failure) via word-boundary regexes and draws a "Terms in this error" card (capped 6) defining each in one sentence, so the log is readable without prior knowledge. Drawn through the window's existing module `DrawSection` loop (no window surgery); toggleable like any module.

**Diagnosis source layering (highest first):** (1) mod-shipped `About/known-issues.json` (`ModShippedIssues` + `Module_ModIssues`) → (2) community bug DB → (3) shipped library → (4) About.xml declared incompatibilities (`AboutIncompatIndex` + `Module_AboutIncompat`). All share `CommunityData.ParseIssues`/`Match`.

**Author guide:** `Documentation/RootCauseAnalysis.md` (shipped; linked from the Extend hint + About).

### Community data (opt-in, `CommunityData`)
Off by default; background fetch, cached (embedded `Json`, gzip), offline fallback. Sources: RimSort Community Rules, Use This Instead, and our own **known-issues.json** at `Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues` (`RepoOwner`/`RepoName` consts; repo is PUBLIC and live, seeded to **14 curated engine-level error signatures** — Harmony/TypeLoad boot failures, uninitialized DefOf, reflection type-load cascade, static-ctor/threaded-mapgen/scribe-loadid/OOM/stack-overflow, xpath/field/def-type, etc.). **Offline snapshot:** the same corpus ships gzipped at `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` (~3.5 KB); `CommunityData.LoadBundledBugsIfNeeded()` loads it as the `_bugs` floor when community data is enabled but no fetch cache exists yet, so enabling community data gives instant offline breadth that a later fetch refreshes.

### In-game reporting API + destination layering (`ReportBuilder`, `Dialog_Report`)
Server-less, secret-free composer (auto-collected block + editable fields + live preview). Destination hierarchy (`CulpritTarget`): culprit mod's OWN GitHub (parse owner/repo from About.xml `<url>`, pre-filled `issues/new?title&body`) → its Steam Workshop page (clipboard) → "Also report to community" → our Issue Form repo. Signature = FNV-1a over exception type + normalized top-6 frame types → `[#xxxxxxxx]`. Repo side staged in `_dev/ModernDevTools/community-db/`.

### Tool 2: dev actions window (`Window_ModernDevActions`, 3-tab)
Reuses vanilla `DebugActionNode` graph. `DebugActions_Testing` adds category "Modern Dev Tools" (top). Whole-tab **breadth-first** search (`SearchResults`, depth cap 6, guard 200000, cap 400; folder/category labels match too) via themed `Palette.SearchField`, auto-focused on open + tab switch. Spawn pickers = searchable icon grid; every mod call hardened (`DebugTree`). Palette-pin path `Actions\<label>`.

### Tool 3: dev palette (`Window_ModernDevPalette`)
Reskins `Dialog_DevPalette`.

### Updated-mod tracking + update notes
`GameComponent_ModSnapshot` diffs save's mods vs current → indicator → `Dialog_ModChanges`. `Dialog_UpdateNotes` once per Version.

### Experimental hardening (two toggles, off by default)
`WindowWatchdog` + `UiHardening` (world/map/global-controls OnGUI finalizers).

### Testing / environment note
Silent crashes during testing traced to **ReShade** (`dxgi.dll`) crashing on focus changes, NOT the mod. Rename `dxgi.dll` to test cleanly.

### Localization
`Languages/English/Keyed/ModernDevTools.xml` (`MDT_*`). New keys this pass: `MDT_ReasonHarmonyPatch`, `MDT_HarmonyConflict*`/`MDT_HarmonyPatched*`, `MDT_DepMissing*`/`MDT_DepInactive`/`MDT_DepOrder*`/`MDT_DepSummary*`/`MDT_DepLine`, `MDT_SectionTerms`, and the `MDT_Gl*` glossary term/definition pairs. Def label/description DefInjected-translatable.

## GitHub Backup
Open source (MIT). Mod repo: **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools** (PUBLIC — private-repo default flipped for this mod). Community bug DB (CC0): **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues** (PUBLIC, `main:/known-issues.json` is the fetch target). `origin` on Astryls; `Source/`, `Assemblies/*.dll`, `.modmixer/`, and `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` are tracked, `Source/**/{bin,obj}` ignored. Matches About.xml `<url>`.
